title: Full-Stack progressive system graph
description: One canonical compound graph plus a projection preset for every lesson currently present in the guide.

lessonProjection: Use lessonOrder to determine which nodes and edges have been introduced by revealThrough.
Start from the roots listed in scope and retain their eligible descendants.
Render a node's children only when the node is in expanded or is an ancestor of a focused node.
When an edge endpoint is hidden inside a collapsed node, attach the edge to its nearest visible ancestor.
Merge projected duplicate edges with the same visible endpoints and label.
Add summaryEdges after projection; they exist only for that lesson view.
Keep stable nodes near their previous positions when changing views.
